If $n \geq 2$ and either $n \leq e^{598}$ or $n \geq e^{1800}$, then
  $p_n \geq n(\log n + \log\log n - 1)$.
  (Art01 writes the thresholds on $p_n$; Dusart, Math.\ Comp.\ 68 (1999),
  citing \cite{massias-robin}, places them on the index $n$.)
